text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --
AUSTRALIA, March 10 - COAL - QUEENSLAND - Abbot Point - Berth vacant. 3 vessels due by 9/4. No delays.
Dalrymple Bay - Four vessels waiting, 13 due by 20/3. Approx. 3-4 days delay expected.
Hound Point - Three vessels waiting, 4 due by 7/4. Approx. 3-4 days delay expected.
Gladstone - R.G. Tanna - 3 Vessels waiting, 22 due by 15/4. No delays.
Barney Point - 1 Vessel due 7/4. No delays.
Brisbane - Berth vacant. 5 Vessels due by 18/4. No delays.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - Pilots returned to work 13.00 hrs. 10/3.
Kooragang - 2 Vessels loading, 12 waiting, 11 due by 21/3. Approx. 7-8 days delay expected.
Channel (Dyke) - 2 Vessels loading, 8 waiting, 17 due by 23/3. Approx. 6-7 days delay expected.
Port Kembla - One vessel loading, 19 due by 4/6. No delays.

IRON ORE - WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Port Hedland - Mt. Newman (Nelson Point) - Due to current shortage of Mt. Newman and Yandi fines, iron ore vessels may experience some delays in berthing/loading or be forced to berth out of turn. A berth - 1 Vessel loading, 3 anchored, 4 due by 17/3. B berth - 1 Vessel loading, 5 anchored, 2 due by 15/3. Other vessels due by 29/3, no eta received.
Goldsworthy (Finucane island) - Due to current shortage of fines and maintenance difficulties, vessels may experience some delays in berthing/loading. One vessels anchored, 2 due by 16/3.
Dampier - Parker Point - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored.
East Intercourse island - 1 Vessel loading, 2 anchored.
Dampier line-up - 27 Vessels due by 29/3 of which 10 for East Intercourse island, 17 for Parker Point.
Port Walcott - Loading stem expected to be back on line from 1900 hrs 12/3 after maintenance. One vessel anchored, 12 due by 31/3.

March 12 - GRAIN - QUEENSLAND - Mackay - No vessels due. Due to insufficient rain, only 1 or 2 export shipments of sorghum expected in May. However, good quantities of rain at present, so a good wheat crop expected for October.
Gladstone - No vessels due.
Brisbane - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting to load wheat, 1 due 28/3 to load wheat.
NEW SOUTH WALES - Newcastle - One vessel loading wheat, 5 waiting to load wheat, 1 barley. 1 Vessel due 17/3 to load wheat. Vessels loading out of turn because of delays in rail receivals of grain.
Port Kembla - Three vessels waiting of which 1 to load barley, 2 wheat. 3 Vessels due by 24/3, all to load wheat.
VICTORIA - Geelong - Two vessels waiting to load wheat. 7 Vessels due by 3/4 of which 4 to load wheat, 2 canola, 1 barley.
Portland - Two vessels loading (1 wheat, 1 barley), 1 waiting to load wheat. 6 Vessels due by 26/3 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 beans, 2 peas, 1 barley.
SOUTH AUSTRALIA - Six vessels due by 1/4 of which 5 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Port Adelaide - Four vessels due by 3/4 of which 3 to load wheat, 1 barley.
Thevenard - One vessel loading wheat, 3 due by 20/3, all to load wheat.
Port Lincoln - One vessel loading wheat, 8 due by 26/3, all to load wheat.
Wallaroo - One vessel loading wheat, 2 waiting to load wheat, 2 due by 20/3 both to load barley.
Ardrossan - No vessels due.
Port Giles - Seven vessels due by 6/4 of which 4 to load wheat, 3 barley.

WESTERN AUSTRALIA - Geraldton - Two vessels loading wheat, 3 waiting of which 2 to load barley, 1 wheat. 9 Vessels due by 5/4 of which 8 to load wheat, 1 feed. Grain loader still experiencing delays due to mechanical failure.
Kwinana - Two vessels loading wheat, 5 waiting to load of which 3 wheat, 1 barley, 1 lupins. 16 Vessels due by 9/4 of which 14 to load wheat, barley.
Albany - One vessel loading wheat, 1 waiting to load wheat. 7 Due by 7/4 of which 4 to load wheat, 2 barley, 1 lupins.
Esperance - Four vessels due by 20/3 of which 2 to load wheat, 1 barley, 1 lupins.
